subject: Multiple duplicate orders appearing in POS system for same customer transactions
description: Between 15:30 and 16:45 IST today, customers ordering through our online aggregator platform (Zomato/Swiggy) are experiencing duplicate order entries in the FoodTech POS terminal. Specifically, when a customer places a single order, the system is creating 2–3 identical order records within 30–60 seconds of the initial transaction. This has caused: (1) Kitchen staff receiving duplicate print tickets leading to food preparation errors; (2) Customer confusion due to multiple charge notifications; (3) Order fulfillment delays as staff attempt to identify which ticket is valid. I have confirmed this affects approximately 12 orders during the incident window. No manual intervention or system restart has resolved the issue yet. The POS terminal (Asset ID: POS-0038-T1) was last rebooted on 2025-11-10. FoodTech POS version running is v5.1.1.

ticket_history.note: Initial assessment completed. Confirmed duplicate order records present in transaction log. Verified network connectivity to aggregator APIs is stable. Recommended cache flush and API gateway reset.
Executed database sync cycle and cleared POS order queue buffer. Duplicate orders ceased appearing after remediation. Monitoring active order stream for recurrence over next 2 hours.

resolution_notes: Issue resolved by clearing the POS order queue buffer and performing a full database synchronization cycle between the terminal and central order management system. Root cause identified as a caching layer timeout in the aggregator API integration causing duplicate transaction submissions. No further duplicate orders observed post-resolution.
